hook_text: A die is not a square, and a tin is not a circle. So what are they?
clip_script: A spaza shop in Pietermaritzburg. Zanele packs the shelves. Cereal box: two rectangle ends joined by rectangles, a rectangular prism. Tent-shaped chocolate box: triangle ends, a triangular prism. Sugar cube: all faces equal squares, a cube. Tin of beans: two circle faces and a curved surface, a cylinder. Ice-cream cone: one circle, one curved surface, one point, a cone. Pyramid tea bags: a base and triangles meeting at the top. Look at the faces, and the name follows.
visual_style: Objects sliding along a shop shelf, each one spinning to show its faces before its name appears.
mood: Friendly and brisk, like a Saturday morning at the corner shop.
pacing: One object per beat, with the die and the tin as the twist.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and name five solid objects in your kitchen.
